w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: You catch Eamon telling the fire about Terry. "Terry came back mauled by The Redactor (15 rounds, 45 taken) and alive. A limp that comes back in the cold now." The story's already growing.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They settled names for 2 beasts: "Ugly-Eyes", "Old Gavel".

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering Spool gorges at the treeline — 560 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔️ Eamon stood down the Callback and kept walking — 1 round, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds Ella — no dodging it.
firstContext: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds Ella — no dodging it.
📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Owen stared at their hands for a long time today. Something is changing.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit HAND DRILL. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Hand drill.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/12/9), with 5 wave-4 fought, 12 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 11 · Craft 8 · Talk 18 · Explore 32 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Eamon returns from the wilds hurt (health 1/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
